problem_statement: The 02:00 campaign run crashed again last night: the consent policy service was slow for a single batch, `PolicyTimeout` escaped from `process_queue` and every batch queued after it was skipped until someone restarted the job. One slow consent lookup should not take down the whole run. Please make queue runs finish cleanly when the consent service times out, so that the remaining batches are still processed and every batch gets an outcome in the run report.
